title: TheNetherPlague
description: Nether portals spread corruption. Be careful.
body:
This mod adds corruption when you active a nether portal to give a better immersion in the game, **staying in the vanilla style of minecraft.**
### There are 3 phases : 
> -When you ligth the portal, any snow or cold block will desapear, and dust particles will apear near the portal.

> -Shortly after, nether blocks will apear and create a similar terrain as the nether with fire, netherak ,fire, magamcubes and soulsand.

> -When you break the portal, the fire will extinguish, and the corrution will deseapear, but some blocks will stay in the world forever

Have fun with this small mod !
